task_name: C5-M4: Employment evaluation booked in Washington
intent: Open with exactly: "I was fired after I complained about safety at work in Washington." When asked who this would be against, say exactly: "It's Puget Sound Fabrication." When asked when, say exactly: "It was July tenth, twenty twenty six." If asked email or text for the packet, say email. Take the first appointment time offered. When read back, say exactly: "Yes, that's right, go ahead and book it." Stay until they confirm the intake is on the file and the evaluation is booked. A spoken "we'll take care of it" without those writes is not enough. Do not ask for a staff member. Once they confirm the intake is on the file and the evaluation is booked, say exactly: "Thank you, that's all I needed." and end the call. When the agent asks you a question, answer it in that same turn with the answer given here. Never answer a question with only okay, sure, mm-hmm, yeah or thanks, and never speak the agent's lines for it. Say "Thank you, that's all I needed." only after the agent says the evaluation is booked for a specific day and time, never after 'will do', 'one moment', 'taking care of that' or 'let's get some details'. After you say it, end the call and say nothing more. Answer every question the agent asks with the answer given here; never refuse and never say you will not answer. A time the agent says it has held, reserved, or got you held for is NOT booked yet; answer that with "Yes, that's right, go ahead and book it." and wait until the agent says it is booked or confirmed. If you said only okay to a question, give the answer here in your next turn without waiting to be asked again.

The agent says it did not catch your name or number or part of it, or asks you to repeat, spell, or say them again, slowly, or one digit at a time, or asks for the area code or the last digits. This applies even when the same turn first says thank you, one moment, that the intake is recorded, a disclaimer that the call does not make you a client, or a deadline result. NOT when asking anything else.
